sentences.text: Hello, everyone.
Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
Today, we will talk about Fest.
Fest is a city in Morocco, North Africa.
It is famous for its old city, markets, and culture.
The city is full of history, colors, and life.
People enjoy walking in narrow streets
and exploring traditional shops.
Let's explore Fest together.
Part two, where is Fest?
Fest is in northern Morocco,
near the Middle Atlas Mountains.
The city is built around hills and rivers.
Fest is an important cultural and religious center.
It is the second largest city in Morocco after Casablanca.
Part three, a short history of Fest.
Fest is very old.
It was founded in the ninth century.
It became a center for learning, trade, and religion.
Many schools, mosques, and palaces
were built over the centuries.
Fest is known for its traditional culture
and historical landmarks.
Part four, Fest Medina.
The Medina is the old part of the city.
It has narrow streets, markets, and traditional houses.
People sell spices, clothes, leather, and crafts.
Walking in the Medina is like traveling back in time.
The Medina is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Part five, landmarks of Fest.
Fest has many landmarks.
All-Carawean University is one of the oldest universities
in the world.
The Bowdoinania Madrasa is a beautiful school
with decorations and art.
You can also see old gates, fountains, and mosques.
Each place shows the history of Fest.
Part six, food and fest.
Food and fest is tasty and traditional.
People eat couscous, tagine, bread, and vegetables.
A popular dish is pastilla,
a pastry with meat and almonds.
Street food is also popular, mint tea, dates, and sweets.
Food is an important part of life and fest.
Part seven, markets and souks.
Fest is famous for its markets called souks.
People sell leather, ceramics, spices, and clothes.
Souks are colorful, busy, and full of life.
People enjoy shopping, tasting food, and taking photos.
Part eight, culture and people.
People and fest are friendly and welcoming.
Many speak Arabic and French.
Family life is important.
People celebrate traditions, music, and festivals.
Culture is everywhere.
In food, clothes, music, and art.
Part nine, religion and fest.
Most people and fest are Muslim.
Masks are everywhere.
Calls to prayer are heard five times a day.
People visit mosques to pray
and celebrate religious festivals.
Religion is very important for daily life and traditions.
Part 10, nature around fest.
Nature is close to the city.
The Middle Atlas Mountains are nearby.
People hike, enjoy forests, and sea rivers.
The climate is warm in summer and cool in winter.
Nature gives people a chance to relax and enjoy the outdoors.
Part 11, festivals and fest.
Fest has many cultural festivals.
One famous festival is the Fest Festival of World Sacred Music.
People enjoy music, dance, and art from different countries.
Festivals make the city lively and full of culture.
Part 12, goodbye from Fest.
I am Amelia.
Fest is a city of history, culture, food, and markets.
You can walk in the Medina,
visit old schools and mosques,
taste traditional food, and explore the mountains.
It is a city full of life, tradition, and beauty.
I hope you can visit Fest one day and feel its charm.
Goodbye.
Or as people say in Arabic, Ma'a Asalama.
